listFields: A customizeTable option since the tables split (0.31); this release changes which views read it.
additionalFields: Computed columns have been an admin option for many releases; this release changes where they are drawn.
RecordForm: Exported from @rebasepro/cms since the composable-primitives work (0.30); only named here as a place that lists fields.
RecordDetail: Exported from @rebasepro/cms since the composable-primitives work (0.30); only named here as a place that lists fields.
fields: The RecordForm / RecordDetail prop, already released; only named here.
form.sections: A customizeTable option already released; only named here.
form.sidebar: A customizeTable option already released; only named here.
kanban.orderField: The board's order option, already released; the change is only to when its hint shows.
ai-instructions.md: Scaffolded by every rebase init since 0.2x; this release only changes its text.
rebase cloud: The command family has shipped for many releases.
rebase cloud domains add: Shipped with custom domains; this release changes its answer for a host already registered.
rebase cloud domains list: Shipped with custom domains; this release adds the certificate state.
rebase schema introspect: Shipped since 0.1x; this release changes what it does to ai-instructions.md.
rebase dev: A command since the first release; this release changes only which requests it logs (a Changed entry), which no docs section describes.
rebase init: A command since the first release; this release changes only the next steps it prints (a Changed entry), which no docs section describes.
